# Domain knowledge

Per-domain architecture and design records for `connect_diagnostics_core`. These
are the authoritative "why it is built this way" notes moved out of `CLAUDE.md` /
`AGENTS.md` so the session-start context stays small. Read the relevant file
**before** working in that area; both Claude and Codex use this one shared tree.

When a domain's architecture, behavior, or constraints change, update the matching
file here in the same change (this replaces keeping the detail in `CLAUDE.md` /
`AGENTS.md`).

| Domain | File |
| ------ | ---- |
| Leave notifications | [leave-notifications.md](leave-notifications.md) |
| Thai payroll | [thai-payroll.md](thai-payroll.md) |
| Payment Request approval | [payment-approval.md](payment-approval.md) |
| Customer onboarding & master data | [customer-master-data.md](customer-master-data.md) |
| Customer sales document requirements | [sales-requirements.md](sales-requirements.md) |
| Regulatory module | [regulatory.md](regulatory.md) |
| DKSH module | [dksh.md](dksh.md) |
| Print formats & audit log | [print.md](print.md) |
| Stock Count | [stock-count.md](stock-count.md) |
